tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs in Flecha with their ids, titles, URLs and Space. `active` marks the tabs the user is looking at; `agent` marks tabs coding agents opened.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a URL in a new background tab, in the sidebar's agent folder, and return its id for the other tools. The user's view and keyboard stay where they are; the other tools work on the tab without showing it.

tools.name: activate_tab
tools.description: Switch the user's view to a tab. Only when the user asks to see it: the other tools don't need the tab on screen.

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab (pinned tabs and favorites are unloaded instead).

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Load a URL in a tab, or go back/forward/reload, and wait for the page to settle.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read a tab's content: visible text (default), full HTML, or its links.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot a tab's viewport, in the background.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: console_logs
tools.description: A tab's recent console messages (errors, warnings, logs), newest last.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click the element matching a CSS selector, with a real mouse event.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into the element matching a selector (or the focused one), optionally clearing it first and pressing Enter.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key such as Enter, Tab, Escape or ArrowDown in a tab.

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a tab's page and return the result (promises are awaited, values are JSON-serialized).

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until an element matching a selector exists (or the page finishes loading when no selector is given).

tabId.description: Flecha tab id, from open_tab or list_tabs
